new_senses.gloss: (mit ʕal) vertrauen, sich auf j-n verlassen;
new_senses.rationale: Six supplied tokens in five verses describe lending money only when repayment can be trusted; ʕal mən/aʕlayye/aʕli explicitly mark the trusted person. One lexical sense covers singular and plural lenders, not a finance-specific subsense.

added_examples.turoyo: Ǧan: Hano ʕal mən məʕtamadwo w ubewolən, ʕal mən məʕtamadwo?
added_examples.translation: Jan: This man, on what would he rely when he gave it to them; on what would he rely?
added_examples.rationale: First Infectum-wa example; interrogative ʕal mən makes government explicit.

added_examples.turoyo: <...> Məʕtamadwo, d lə məʕtamadwo l ubewole, d ubewole l ḥa ʕaṣyo? Lə ubewole. <...>
added_examples.translation: <...> He trusted him; if he did not trust him he would not give it to him. Would he give it to a rebel? He would not give it to him. <...>
added_examples.rationale: Contrasts trust and its negation in the lending decision; one shared quotation for two tokens.

added_examples.turoyo: <...> Ubewolle dlo əmḏa, məʕtamadwo aʕlayye, ṣəroye məʕtamadwo. <...>
added_examples.translation: <...> He would give it to them without a signature; he trusted them, he trusted the Christians. <...>
added_examples.rationale: Explicit aʕlayye stimulus and omitted/preposed trusted group, preserving source argument alternation.

added_examples.turoyo: <...> E d məʕtamdiwo aʕlayye ubiwonne. D lə məʕtamdiwo aʕlayye, d lə madʕərənne l ubiwonne.
added_examples.translation: <...> Yes, those whom they trusted, they would give it to them. Those whom they did not trust, who would not return it, they would not give it to them.
added_examples.rationale: Plural lenders and explicit return-of-money criterion; no extra finance sense.

added_examples.turoyo: Əno, masala kətli lazəm l ʕəsri (20) yawme l mo (100) alfo noṭat, azzino l gab Xori Nəʕman haka məʕtamadle aʕli, gurašwo mi banqa ubewoli. <...>
added_examples.translation: I, for instance, need a hundred thousand (100,000) notes for twenty (20) days. I would go to Khori Neman; if he trusted me, he would draw it from the bank and give it to me. <...>
added_examples.rationale: First Preterit example; l-agent form in a conditional protasis with ʕal stimulus.
